summary:
I found no hidden global downscale. On the buildings I could measure, the model height divided by the measured height comes out at 0.96 to 1.04, which is within the errors. The skew is per building, not global.
- Fix with high confidence. HallWing is too low by 1.24 m (eave above the north ground: model 3.02, measured 4.26 ± 0.38). Canteen is too high by 1.75 m (model 5.02, measured 3.27 ± 0.23). Both come from shadows in Bing, Google and Esri, calibrated on C. The current specs look roughly swapped between these two: Canteen eave 4.3, HallWing 2.4.
- Fix with low-medium confidence:
  - B wall top is +0.36 ± 0.21 m above the model (photo camera solve). The window rows match.
  - A_S south face does have 4 window rows. But the spec squeezes them under a 9.45 eave: with the A271 photo scale, the F3 sill is +1.0 and the top-row head +0.95 above the spec, and a scale-free row-spacing ratio is 0.78 against the spec's 0.56. So the A_S eave needs to be about +1.0 m.
- OK:
  - C (self-consistent).
  - Hall: model higher than measured by 0.25 ± 0.46 m.
  - A_E: model lower by 0.04 ± 0.21 m.
  - A_N: wall top at 14.75 ± 0.5 m against 14.77 in the model, from a photo with C in the same frame.
- Unsure, with no reliable method: D_M and D_W (shadows fall on dark ground in all 3 orthos), HallEast, Pavilion (+0.32 ± 0.29 from one source), A_W, GateBooth (−0.25 to −0.3), and the context towers (shadows cut off by the next block).
- The specs changed while I was auditing (Hall, HallEast, HallWing, Canteen). All model numbers use the specs as of 2026-10-02.

global_checks.result: Model/measured on independently measured buildings: Hall 1.04, A_E 0.99, B 0.96, A_N(photo) 1.00; C kappa Bing e7 0.611 vs e5 0.600 (1.8%). No common factor; deviations are building-specific (HallWing 0.71, Canteen 1.54).

global_checks.check: Shadow kappa calibration on C (per ortho, north faces, s=T-E on the roof-edge-to-tip, lean included)
global_checks.result: Bing 0.605+-0.010 (C e7 9.71 m / H 15.89; e5 9.61 / 16.03); Google z20 0.434+-0.036 (C e7 6.92/15.97; e5 8.13 judged contaminated, used as bound); Esri 1.086+-0.055 (C west part 17.74/16.33, tip west of canteen)

global_checks.check: Cross-source consistency of shadow heights (Esri/Bing ratio)
global_checks.result: Hall 1.19, HallWing 1.19, Canteen 1.13, A_E 1.03 -> +-7% source scatter, carried into the per-building errors

global_checks.check: Plan-scale sanity of photo PnP (camera height comes out physical)
global_checks.result: B Kodak photo: camera 1.68-1.74 m above the SE grade (eye height), focal fit 34.3 mm vs EXIF 35; A212: camera z 7.4-8.8 abs (alley ~6.5-7 + eye), rms 3.6-4.1 px on 52 C window-surround corners
On campus the shadows point due N (HallWing E-end shadow flush with the roof edge +-0.2 m). Over the NE towers Bing is a different strongly leaning capture, so kappa is NOT valid there

Rejected after visual check: A_N/B north (hedge/trees in Bing), Pavilion (Bing/Google hedge), all D north faces (dark strip in Bing/Esri, suspect band in Google), towers (tip on the next block's facade), A_S north (covered)

Hall (eave 5.5->5.9, FFL 5.8->5.4), HallEast (3.3->3.7), HallWing (2.5->2.4), Canteen (3.05->4.3, pitch 18) changed today while the audit ran; all model numbers here use the specs as of 2026-10-02 ~14:00 (built .blend is older)

open_questions: A_S: tape/laser the top-row (strip window) sill height on the south face above the storefront threshold. 9.45 confirms the spec; ~9.9-10.0 confirms the +1 m fix. Also check whether A_N's eave matches it.

Canteen: measure the north eave (gutter) height above the paving. The spec's 'eave 4.75 above paving' (070410255 t=46 s) contradicts three orthos (3.0-3.6 m). It may show the HallWing, which the orthos put at ~4.3 m.
HallEast: laser the SE corner top (high edge of the shed roof) above the plaza paving; no reliable photo or shadow measurement exists.
B: one laser reading from the paving to the soffit at the SE corner. The ~2009 photo gives 8.51 +- 0.21 above the SE grade; the 2020 pano gave 8.15.
D_W / D_M: one eave height (and the D_W canopy eave), because every ortho shadow north of D lands on dark ground.
GateBooth: tape from the paving to the canopy soffit at all four corners. The model terrain falls 0.7 m under the booth; the photographed corner is 3.10 m.
Pavilion: tape the north eave above the walkway (Esri alone gives 4.97 +- 0.29 m against 4.65).
